meta.name: Official source registry
meta.rule: Only league, team, school, network, station and governing-body sites are treated as official. Every table row on the site links to one of these URLs. A value that cannot be confirmed on the linked official page is left blank and listed on the Flagged for Review page.
meta.note: Third-party duration research is listed separately in durations.json as explanatory research, never as an official schedule value.
